items.title: Plas Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: young Ricky Nelson, I played on his stuff

ctx.x: Yeah, Pat Boone started doing a Fats Domino thing. Well that’s taking the hit one step higher, because I’m sure he could sell so many more records on that. And young Ricky Nelson, I played on his stuff, and he did some Fats Domino, “I’m Walking.”
When you would do these things, the recording at that time, were they done in parts or did everybody play together? © Fillius Jazz Archive -4-
